answer.sourceLine: Wikiquote ties this wording to Freeman Dyson’s “Innovation in Physics,” Scientific American, September 1958, and a discussion of Wolfgang Pauli’s theory. We did not independently inspect Dyson’s article, so retain an attributed verdict.
